info.title: Caplia Investor API
info.description: Public REST API for the Caplia Investor Portal. Auth: `Authorization: Bearer cap_inv_live_<32 chars>`.

post.summary: Issue a short-lived upload token for a public form

properties.description: The form team's custom properties (live config) — render these as form fields and pass selections via `properties` on POST /v1/uploads/decks.

404.description: Not found or out of scope

post.summary: Submit a deck using a short-lived upload token

properties.description: JSON object mapping a custom property (name or id) to an option (label or id). Valid values are returned by POST /v1/uploads/sign for this form. Unknown entries are ignored.

post.summary: Recognise whether an email is linked to a Caplia Passport

200.description: Whether the email is linked to a Caplia Passport holder

404.description: Not found or out of scope

200.description: Companies whose name matches the query that the caller can read (RLS-scoped)

schema.description: Filter by a custom property (name or id, see GET /v1/properties). Pair with `value`. Example: find the company you submitted with your own reference by storing it in a property and querying property=Application ID&value=APP-123.

The property value to match: the answer string for text properties (exact, case-sensitive), or an option label or id for select/multi_select (archived options accepted, so historical rows stay findable).

200.description: Paginated list of companies in the caller's pipeline

pipeline_ids.description: Pipeline ids to add the company to (one deal per pipeline, e.g. one per award entered). Must be live pipelines of your team; ids are supplied by your Caplia contact. Omitted: the team's default intake pipeline.

properties.description: JSON object mapping a custom property (name or id) to an option (label or id), e.g. {"Award Category":"Climate Tech"}. Discover valid values via GET /v1/properties. Unknown entries are ignored.

pipeline_ids.description: Pipeline ids for the resulting deal, as a JSON array (e.g. ["<uuid>","<uuid>"]) or comma-separated list. One deal per pipeline — a company entering several awards names each award's pipeline. Must be live pipelines of your team (ids supplied by your Caplia contact). Omitted: the team's default intake pipeline.

202.description: Accepted; deck queued for processing. Poll poll_url until status is completed and STORE the returned company_id — it is the durable reference for reading this company back (scores, metrics, updates). If you fire-and-forget instead, you can recover the company later by querying GET /v1/companies?property=…&value=… on a reference you submitted in properties.
